Color Palette Generator

Harmonious color palettes from one base color.

Click any swatch to copy its hex code.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a base color with the color picker.
  2. Six harmony rows appear instantly below.
  3. Click any swatch to copy its hex code.
  4. Use the palettes in your designs, websites or branding.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which color schemes are generated?

Six schemes: analogous, complementary, triadic, split-complementary, square and monochromatic — five swatches each, computed from your color's position on the color wheel.

Will these colors look good together?

Yes. Analogous schemes use colors next to each other on the wheel, so they always blend smoothly. Complementary and triadic schemes give stronger contrast.

How do I copy a color?

Click any swatch to copy its hex code to the clipboard.
